title: Domains
subtitle: Connect and manage Cloudflare zones for automatic custom-domain deployments.
emptyDescription: Add one or more Cloudflare zones to automate DNS records for every domain you deploy.
addDescription: Connect another zone for automatic DNS management.
editDescription: Update this zone's credentials and DNS defaults.
domainHint: Enter the parent zone shown in Cloudflare, not an app subdomain.
zoneIdHint: Cloudflare Dashboard → your domain → Overview → API → Zone ID.
tokenPlaceholderSaved: Saved — leave blank to keep it
tokenHint: Required permissions: Zone → DNS → Edit and Zone → Zone → Read.
proxyDescription: Enable the orange-cloud proxy for records created by Vibrail.
disconnectDescription: Vibrail will stop managing new DNS changes. Existing Cloudflare records are left in place.
workflowDescription: After this connection is verified, custom domains in the deploy form are automated.
stepOneDescription: Save the parent domain, Zone ID and API token here.
stepThreeDescription: Vibrail points an A record to the selected server and adds the Traefik route.
securityDescription: The API token is encrypted at rest. It is never sent to the user server, Traefik container or application container.
